name: QA-1124-EPD-01: EPD set in the Calculator/Offer phase appears in the generated contract
description:
Objective: EPD set in the Calculator/Offer phase appears in the generated contract.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Follow the reproduction steps of QA-1124-EPD-01.
2. Evaluate the encoded checks in `test_epd_configured_before_generation_appears_in_the_contract`.
3. Record any mismatch.
Expected: 1. EPD set in the Calculator/Offer phase appears in the generated contract.
2. The bug's expected result holds; no unintended record or state residue.
